scenes.title: Patient tracking a horizontal LED light-bar saccade wand across a sunlit clinic room as SUD distress drops from 8 to 1

layout.description: Sunlit, calm clinical therapy office with two comfortable armchairs angled politely, a sleek horizontal desktop LED light-bar mounted on a stand sweeping a crisp warm dot smoothly left-to-right at eye level, and a 0-to-10 Subjective Units of Disturbance (SUD) rating card.

positions.where: seated upright with steady grounded posture, eyes tracking the horizontal sweeping light dot cleanly from left to right across 24 rhythmic passes

positions.who: Clinician mannequin (Francine Shapiro style blazer and blouse)
positions.where: seated slightly to the side adjusting the bilateral sweep pace while logging the 0-to-10 SUD drop on a clipboard

props.name: horizontal bilateral LED light-bar
props.period_detail: sleek 24-inch matte-aluminum bar displaying a single crisp amber-white dot gliding smoothly left-to-right-to-left
props.physical_behavior: drives rhythmic horizontal saccades at ~1 cycle per second

props.name: 0-to-10 SUD rating scale card
props.period_detail: clean visual scale where the marker slides from '8 — High Distress' down to '1 — Calm'
props.physical_behavior: quantifies emotional de-escalation while factual recall stays clear

props.name: 3-node Nature circuit placard
props.period_detail: clean schematic on side desk reading 'Orienting (SC) -> Mediodorsal Thalamus -> Amygdala Brake'
props.physical_behavior: connects clinical eye tracking to 2019 circuit proof

actions.verb_sequence: recalls a distressing memory briefly with tense shoulders (SUD 8) -> tracks 24 smooth left-right passes on the horizontal light bar -> exhales deeply as shoulders drop
pauses the light bar -> checks in calmly -> slides the SUD marker down toward 1

reactions.reaction: reports the memory still exists factually, yet feels distant and drained of panic
records intact factual recall paired with quieted autonomic distress

scenes.wardrobe: Clean documentary clinical attire: soft wool sweater and slacks on patient; tailored blazer and white blouse on clinician.
scenes.lighting: Warm, reassuring high-key California window daylight.
scenes.recognition_hook: Tracking a simple light gliding left and right while recalling a 20-year-old memory sounded too weird to be true — until 2019 circuit recordings caught it physically braking the amygdala.

key_visual.description: a patient in a sunlit therapy armchair tracking a horizontal left-to-right LED light bar while a clinician logs a 0-to-10 distress scale dropping from 8 to 1

layout.description: Bright tree-lined park path with dappled daylight across oak trunks.

positions.where: walking briskly along the park path noticing her eyes scanning left-to-right across tree trunks

props.name: small pocket field notebook
props.period_detail: opened on a park bench to jot down the unexpected eye-movement observation

actions.verb_sequence: notices distressing thought fade after rapid horizontal glances -> tests deliberate saccades on a bench

reactions.reaction: writes the testable protocol into her notebook

scenes.recognition_hook: A chance observation on a 1987 park walk launched thirty years of clinical trials and circuit debates.

scenes.title: 2019 KAIST Nature alternating LED cylinder circuit proof

layout.description: Clean modern laboratory bench with a translucent cylindrical arena ringed by sequential left-right white LED strips beside a clear circuit monitor.

positions.where: orienting head calmly left-and-right toward alternating LED flashes instead of freezing

positions.who: Jinhee Baek mannequin in white lab coat
positions.where: pointing to silenced basolateral amygdala spike traces on the monitor

props.name: alternating bilateral LED ring & spike monitor
props.physical_behavior: outperforms chaotic flicker and extinction alone

actions.verb_sequence: sweep left-right -> Porcelain mouse tracks smoothly without freezing -> amygdala fear spikes drop flat

reactions.reaction: maps the SC -> MD thalamus -> BLA inhibitory bridge

scenes.wardrobe: Crisp white laboratory coat; articulated matte-white porcelain mouse sculpture.
scenes.recognition_hook: In 2019 Nature recordings, only rhythmic left-right alternating flashes fired the thalamic brake that silenced amygdala fear cells.

scenes.title: Brisk outdoor forward walk while decompressing from a stressful day

layout.description: Sunlit wide park trail where two friends walk briskly side-by-side scanning the horizon naturally while talking calmly.

positions.where: walking steadily forward along a bright park path

props.name: open sunlit horizon path
props.period_detail: natural bilateral stepping and visual optic flow

actions.verb_sequence: walks briskly scanning trees ahead while talking through a hard week -> tension melts noticeably

reactions.reaction: breathes easier than when ruminating motionless on a couch
